limitations: Single metadata sample per scenario and code version; final acceptance must repeat after fixing the regression.
WAL file length includes reused/unreclaimed capacity; it is not cumulative physical disk writes.
Direct writer and range-reader timing is not live admission backlog or UI latency.
External time resource report includes cargo compilation and the whole suite, not per-case CPU/RSS.
Physical power loss, native Tauri and mobile devices are not validated by these results.
